Subject: Marketplace listing copy + co-sell ops ahead of launch

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for routing this. We reviewed the first draft of the AWS listing and pulled together a short list of questions and a few content tweaks we'd like your team to consider before the final upload. High level:

- Headline tone: our SDRs have been testing a couple of short-phrase variants; one emphasizes "Predictable LLM inference at scale" and another focuses on "Lower per-token cost for production apps." Would love your guidance on which aligns with Redwood's voice.
- Billing blurb: legal wants clearer language on metering units and a note about free-trial limits.
- Co-sell blurb: we need a 2-3 line callout for the partner co-sell program and a named contact for procurement.

I've attached the draft copy and our internal SKU mapping for reference (aws_listing_draft_v3.docx, sku-mapping.csv). Also attaching a preliminary co-sell deck that we intend to share with our reseller partners (co-sell-enablement-deck.pptx).

Can your team do a quick copy QC and mark any changes inline by end of Tuesday PT? We're on a tight timeline for the marketplace submission window.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min sync if that helps.

Sara
Sara Patel | Head of Partnerships
CloudVelocity Inc.

Sara — thanks for the attachments and the clear asks. Quick responses inline below, and we'll push an annotated copy to the Google Doc tonight.

- Headline: recommend the "Predictable LLM inference at scale" variant as primary; it maps better to our product page claims and perf-first positioning. We can A/B test the cost-focused headline in the hero for paid traffic.
- Billing blurb: agree we should add one sentence on metering: "Charges are based on input + output tokens per the AWS usage metric; see SKU details for per-request units." I'll draft the exact phrasing for legal sign-off.
- Co-sell blurb: provide the partner program line and procurement contact — can you confirm whether CloudVelocity requires a named contact for initial orders or a general procurement email?

Marissa — can you and Mateo review the co-sell copy in the attached deck and confirm it's co-sell-ready? Key asks: one slide for steps to co-sell, one slide for technical prerequisites (VPC/private deployment notes), and a 1-line partner callout for the marketplace product page.

If helpful, I'll schedule a 20-min launch sync tomorrow at 10:00 PT.

Thanks,

> Marissa — can you and Mateo review the co-sell copy in the attached deck and confirm it's co-sell-ready?

Quick pass from product/launch POV — noted in the Google Doc (link below). Highlights:

- Hero & subhead: tighten subhead to single sentence. Suggested: "Deploy open and proprietary LLMs with predictable latency, cost, and SLAs." Shorter helps for mobile.
- Benefit bullets: reorder to lead with latency and reliability, followed by cost controls and private deployment.
- CTA: two CTAs recommended on the marketplace page: "Start trial" (primary) and "Request a co-sell intro" (secondary). The secondary CTA should open a short form that routes to partner.sales@redwoodinference.com.
- Legal copy: add a parenthetical for trial limits (e.g., 500k tokens for 14 days) and link to the usage doc.

I've updated the co-sell deck: renamed slide 3 to "Co-sell: partner flow & roles" and added a one-line marketplace blurb suitable for the product page. Jonas — can you confirm the SKU mapping rows 4-7 match the Dedicated vs Hosted offerings?

Google Doc (annotated): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFgHIjk-launch-copy
